description: Defines the 'TernaryPlot' class for rendering an interactive soil composition ternary plot using SVG and Snap.svg library, including methods for creating SVG elements, configuring plot parameters, drawing soil type polygons, adding labels, legend, and interactive blip markers.

classes.name: TernaryPlot
classes.description: Class for creating and managing a soil composition ternary plot visualization.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TernaryPlot instance, loads SVG library, and sets up the plot.

methods.name: make_svg
methods.description: Creates the SVG element and appends it to the parent container.

methods.name: init_snap
methods.description: Initializes the Snap.svg paper object for drawing.

methods.name: init_config
methods.description: Sets default configuration parameters and calculates soil type polygon coordinates.

methods.name: get_coords
methods.description: Returns the coordinate points for a specified soil type polygon.

methods.name: get_color
methods.description: Returns the color associated with a specified soil type.

methods.name: make_plot
methods.description: Draws soil type polygons on the SVG canvas.

methods.name: make_plot_marking
methods.description: Adds labels for soil types on the plot.

methods.name: make_legend
methods.description: Creates a legend for soil types with color boxes and labels.

methods.name: mark_blip
methods.description: Places a marker (blip) on the plot based on soil composition percentages.

methods.name: remove_blip
methods.description: Removes the blip marker from the plot.
